page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 58 at left. Centred heading "616. Syri." Then one column of running text. Below the text a rule and at the right the catchword-like word "CAPUT" in spaced capitals, set below the rule.

main_text.head: 616. Syri.
main_text.p: Anno ab Alexandro ( sic Seleucidarum Epocham notant Syri ) 927. apparet sacros libros conversos in linguam Syriacam ( ex Graeco exemplari, quod manu Eusebii ad Origenis libros, qui in Caesarensis Ecclesiae Bibliotheca asservabantur, fuerat emendatum ) & scriptos Alexandriae: ex quibus Andreas Masius se Deuteronomii bonam partem una cum libris historicis MS. habuisse testatur. [ praefat. in Josuam, p. 6. & 123.

page.notes: The word "Anno" opens with a large initial. "Syri" in heading is set as printed. The bottom word "CAPUT" is set spaced at the right, apart from the text; it is treated as a catchword, as it stands alone at the right below the last line. Heading "616. Syri." is printed in a larger type, so it is a level 2 heading. Text is printed with the long s rendered as s. Some words in the first line are faint but legible.
